      About this item

      • All-in-One Charging Design: This portable charger power bank combines a foldable AC wall plug, a built-in Lightning cable, a built-in 2-in-1 USB-C/Micro-USB cable, and a USB-A output port. The separate USB-C port is for recharging the battery pack only. Power compatible devices without carrying extra charging cables or a separate wall charger
      • 22.5W Fast Charging & Power 3 Devices at Once: This portable phone charger supports power bank fast charging at up to 22.5W when powering one compatible device. Charge up to 3 devices simultaneously through the built-in Lightning cable, 2-in-1 USB-C/Micro-USB cable, and USB-A port. When multiple devices are connected, total output is shared up to 15W (5V/3A)
      • 20,000mAh Long-Lasting Backup Power: This portable battery pack charger provides approximately 4 charges for iPhone 15, 3 charges for Samsung Galaxy, or 1.6 charges for an 11-inch iPad Pro. Designed as a portable charger for iPhone and other compatible devices, it is ideal for flights, camping, road trips, festivals, long workdays, and emergency backup
      • Digital Display & Carry-On Ready: This portable power bank features a clear digital display that shows the remaining battery level from 0% to 100%. Measuring 5.91 × 2.83 × 1.09 inches and weighing 12.9 ounces, it is designed for backpacks, work bags, and carry-on luggage. Rated at 77Wh, this portable power bank for iPhone is ready for carry-on air travel
      • Two Convenient Ways to Recharge: This portable phone charger battery pack can be recharged directly through the built-in AC wall plug in approximately 11 hours or through the USB-C input with a compatible 9V/2A charger in approximately 6.5 hours. The AC input supports 100–240V, 50/60Hz. Pass-through charging is available only when using the AC plug
      • 3-Year Support & Multi-Layer Protection: The Charmast portable charger is supported by ETL, CE, FCC, and UL test reports and features built-in safeguards against overvoltage, overcurrent, overload, and short circuits. Customer support replies within 24 hours, and this portable battery charger comes with a 3-year warranty for added peace of mind

      • Can this be taken on a plane?

        The battery capacity of this power bank is within 100Wh, so it's approved within airline's limits. You can carry it in your carry-on luggage. However, please note that you cannot put your portable charger in your checked baggage.

      • Does this support PD/QC fast charging?

        Sure, this power bank features multiple fast charging protocols and supports QC/PD fast charging.

      • How much time it will take to fully recharged the power bank?

        It is recommended to insert a charging cable of 18W or above into type-c port to recharge this power bank, which only takes 6 hours to fully charge this 20,000mah power bank.

      • Can this power bank work at different voltages during travel?

        This portable chargers work with voltages between 100-240V and can work fine without a voltage converter.

      How customer reviews and ratings work

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      Customers say

      Customers praise the power bank's portability, with one noting it's a well-designed solution for everyday and travel use, and appreciate its built-in wall plug and ability to charge multiple devices simultaneously. The charging speed receives mixed feedback - while some say it charges quickly, others report it takes too long. Moreover, the product's reliability is mixed, with some finding it dependable while others report it stopped working after a few uses.       Product Description

      The Charmast 20000mAh portable charger power bank combines a foldable AC wall plug, a built-in Lightning cable, a built-in 2-in-1 USB-C/Micro-USB cable, a USB-A output port and a clear digital battery display in one all-in-one design. The separate USB-C port is for recharging the power bank only. Use it as a portable phone charger, external battery power bank or travel battery pack for long workdays, business trips, vacations, road trips, camping and emergency backup. Choose between two convenient ways to recharge the power bank. Plug the built-in AC wall plug directly into a firm, upright wall outlet for a full recharge in approximately 11 hours, or use the USB-C input with a compatible 9V/2A charger for a full recharge in approximately 6.5 hours. The AC input supports 100–240V, 50/60Hz; a plug adapter may be required outside the US. Pass-through charging is available only when using the AC plug. Fold the wall plug back into the housing after use. Designed to power up to 3 devices simultaneously, this portable charger with built-in cables delivers power through the Lightning cable, 2-in-1 USB-C/Micro-USB cable and USB-A port. It supports power bank fast charging at up to 22.5W when charging one compatible device. When multiple devices are connected, total output is shared up to 15W (5V/3A). The built-in connectors support compatible Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel and other Android devices. For low-current devices such as an Apple Watch, use the original charging cable with the USB-A port and activate low-current mode by pressing and holding the power button for 2 seconds. With a 20000mAh battery capacity, this portable battery charger provides approximately 4 charges for iPhone 15, 3 charges for Samsung Galaxy or 1.6 charges for an 11-inch iPad Pro. Measuring 5.91 × 2.83 × 1.09 inches and weighing 12.9 ounces, it is designed for backpacks, work bags and carry-on luggage. The digital LED display shows the remaining battery level from 0% to 100%, helping you know when it is time to recharge. Rated at 77Wh, this portable power bank for iPhone and other compatible devices is below the common 100Wh carry-on battery limit. Keep the power bank in carry-on baggage only, not checked luggage, and confirm your airline’s latest requirements before traveling. Built-in safeguards help protect against overvoltage, overcurrent, overload and short circuits. Charmast customer support replies within 24 hours, and the portable charger includes a 3-year warranty for added peace of mind.
